method.purpose: Separate concept completeness from implementation readiness without inventing permissions, quantities or budgets.

readiness_scale.R1: concept only; official evidence and responsible owner are missing
readiness_scale.R2: evidence plan exists; site verification and authorization are still required
readiness_scale.R3: bounded tabletop or reversible prototype is specified; real-world opening remains conditional
readiness_scale.R4: site action can begin after named owner and listed entry evidence are recorded

method.cost_rule: S/M/L are relative complexity bands only, not investment estimates.
method.claim_limit: No row is a planning approval, construction authorization, cost estimate, safety certification or government endorsement.

overall_verdict.now: Concept review, official-source reconciliation, six-gate field audit and owner/rights mapping can begin.
overall_verdict.next: A low-tech civic baseline and one reversible 90-day Veranda Receipt pilot may proceed only after named owners and gate evidence exist.
overall_verdict.not_ready: Rail crossings, bridges/tunnels, permanent buildings, statutory indicators and capital budgets are not implementation-ready.

rows.scope: Built public-space baseline and six-gate field audit
rows.acceptance: dated field audit with issue, rights, access and safety evidence

rows.scope: Shade, seating, wayfinding and staffed-service baseline
rows.acceptance: maintainable low-tech prototype with signed service owner
rows.stop: no maintenance owner, inaccessible route or unresolved utility/fire conflict

rows.owner_type: pilot sponsor, site steward, data/IP reviewer and accessibility co-reviewer
rows.acceptance: one positive and four negative cases re-run; public notice and rollback rehearsed
rows.stop: any gate fails; freeze, hand off to people and execute rollback

rows.scope: Permanent rail crossings, tunnels, bridges and buildings
rows.owner_type: competent authority, rights holders and multi-discipline chief team
rows.acceptance: professional design and approval path defined from official evidence
rows.stop: keep conceptual until every dependency exists

next_evidence_sequence: obtain site permission and rights-cleared official geometry
complete six-gate field audit with disabled and older-user co-review
name owner, maintenance window, staffed equivalent, insurance and exit funding
run one passive prototype before any live-data or automated service
publish adopt, revise or retire receipt after the 90-day gate review
